Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National | Politics Ablekuma West: Roni Nicol declares third bid for NPP parliamentary candidacy 11 November 2026 11:40pm Roni Nicol ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Roni Nicol, a long-standing member of the New Patriotic Party (NPP), has declared his intention to contest the party’s parliamentary primary in Ablekuma West ahead of the 2028 general elections.
The declaration marks his third attempt to become the party’s parliamentary candidate for the constituency, having contested the position in 2016 and 2024.
Mr Nicol said his decision was informed by more than 20 years of service to the party, which he described as loyal, selfless and humble.
He also highlighted his longstanding connection to the constituency, saying he had lived, schooled and worshipped there for more than 30 years.
“For over 30 years, Ablekuma West has been my home. I schooled here, I worship here, I grew here. Ablekuma West is my heart,” he said.
Mr Nicol said his previous electoral contests and grassroots political experience had prepared him to lead the NPP in its bid to reclaim the parliamentary seat from the National Democratic Congress (NDC).
He pledged to pursue an inclusive campaign focused on job creation for young people, support for businesses and unity within the party.
He also called for accountable leadership and urged party members to work together towards victory in the 2028 elections.
“Together, let us win back Ablekuma West. Together, let us give our people a united, humble and accountable representation they deserve,” he said.
He appealed to delegates and constituents for their support and prayers as the party prepares for the 2028 electoral contest.
